disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of certificate for any violation of this Part after notice and hearing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The council shall have the authority to suspend or revoke certificates of registration upon any violation of this Part after notice and a proper hearing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prohibition on conducting plan review or inspections on a structure in which the officer owns any interest in the legal entity that constructed it.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A building code enforcement officer, third-party provider, or third-party provider contracted by a jurisdiction as provided for in R.S. 40:1730.24(A) shall not conduct plan review or inspections on a commercial or residential structure if such officer or provider owns any interest in the legal entity that constructed such commercial or residential structure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prohibition on receiving compensation from the legal entity that constructed the structure other than fees charged for plan review or inspections.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: or receives any compensation from the legal entity other than the fees that are charged for plan review or inspections

disciplinary_grounds.description: Building official or certified building inspector may not be appointed if they have any interest in any legal entity that performs commercial or residential construction within the jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No building official or certified building inspector shall be appointed if he has any interest in any legal entity that performs commercial or residential construction within the jurisdiction in which he would be appointed.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Each parish and municipality shall appoint a council-certified building official or contract with other governmental entities or third parties as authorized in R.S. 40:1730.24 of this Part so that the unincorporated area of the parish is under the jurisdiction of a council-certified building official.

definition_quote.value: a person employed by a public entity who is primarily responsible for the overall inspection or enforcement of applicable building code requirements within the jurisdiction of the employer
definition_quote.quote: "building codes enforcement officer" means a person employed by a public entity who is primarily responsible for the overall inspection or enforcement of applicable building code requirements within the jurisdiction of the employer.

value: examination or review of plans, drawings, or specifications
issuance, denial, or revocation of permits
methods_authorized.quote: Enforcement procedures by building code enforcement officers or third-party providers acting in the capacity of a building code enforcement officer shall include examination or review of plans, drawings, or specifications; the conducting of inspections; and the issuance, denial, or revocation of permits.

certification_categories.quote: the Louisiana State Uniform Construction Code Council shall certify a person performing building codes enforcement including building officials, plans reviewers, and inspectors.

decertification_authority.quote: The council shall have the authority to suspend or revoke certificates of registration upon any violation of this Part after notice and a proper hearing.

certification_waiver_available.quote: beginning August 1, 2008, and upon application and fulfillment of all other requirements necessary to obtain a certificate of registration, an employee of the state of Louisiana or one of its political subdivisions who is a Louisiana licensed architect or engineer shall be granted a certificate of registration without certification by a recognized building code organization or testing agency.

financial_interest_prohibition.quote: A building code enforcement officer, third-party provider, or third-party provider contracted by a jurisdiction as provided for in R.S. 40:1730.24(A) shall not conduct plan review or inspections on a commercial or residential structure if such officer or provider owns any interest in the legal entity that constructed such commercial or residential structure

adopted_model_code.value: International Building Code, International Residential Code, International Existing Building Code, International Mechanical Code, International Plumbing Code, International Fuel Gas Code, International Energy Conservation Code, National Electric Code
adopted_model_code.quote: the council shall evaluate, adopt, and amend only the latest editions of the following as the State Uniform Construction Code: (1) International Building Code ... (2) International Existing Building Code ... (3) International Residential Code ... (4) International Mechanical Code ... (5) The International Plumbing Code ... (6) International Fuel Gas Code ... (7) International Energy Conservation Code ... (8) National Electric Code.

state_preempts_local_codes.quote: all municipalities and parishes in this state shall enforce only the construction codes provided for in this Part.

municipality_may_exceed_minimum.quote: Nothing in this Section shall allow any local government to avoid enforcement or otherwise amend any of the mandatory construction code provisions required by R.S. 40:1730.28

value: building code enforcement officers employed by municipality or parish
certified third-party providers contracted by the municipality, parish, or regional planning commission
agreements with other governmental entities of the state
enforcement_delivery_options.quote: All municipalities and parishes shall use building code enforcement officers or certified third-party providers contracted by the municipality, parish, or regional planning commission to act in the capacity of a building code enforcement officer to enforce the provisions of this Part.

value: private outdoor recreational structures (e.g., hunting or fishing camps)
residential accessory structures (not exceeding 500 sq ft, outside high-wind regions)
industrial facilities within secured/fenced confines under specified NAICS codes
exempt_building_types.quote: The governing authority of a parish or municipality shall not enforce that portion of the state uniform construction code which regulates the construction or improvement of a farm structure or private outdoor recreational structure, other than a residence or structure attached to a residence, such as a hunting or fishing camp or residential accessory structure.
